List all approved drugs indicated for hypertension. Return the following columns: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Filter by max_phase_for_ind = 4 and mesh_heading = 'Hypertension'. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
